name: Better QR Codes
description: Create editable PCB QR codes with rounded modules, styled finders, and configurable knockouts.
description_full: Better QR Codes is a KiCad PCB Editor action plugin for creating and re-editing QR Code Model 2 artwork. It supports physical sizing, error-correction and layer selection, rounded data modules and finder patterns, plus configurable knockout backgrounds. Styling is deliberately kept separate from QR encoding so required symbol structures remain intact.
